subject: Redwood demo — time lattice & IT/SE handshake
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@voltiva.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood demo — proposed windows & IT/security check (Voltiva)

Hi Maria — thanks for signing up and welcome to Redwood. I’m Priyom on the SDR team; I’ll do the warm handoff to make scheduling as simple as possible.

Ava (AE) and Soojin (SE) are looped in — quick ask before we lock a time: can you confirm which Voltiva stakeholders (product, IT/security, any procurement reps) need to attend? SE will want a short security/architecture section and we’d like IT on the line.

Proposed 45-minute windows (all show as UTC and then Redwood local conversions):
- Option A: Wed, Nov 18 — 10:00–10:45 UTC (PST: 02:00–02:45; EST: 05:00–05:45)
- Option B: Wed, Nov 18 — 11:30–12:15 UTC (PST: 03:30–04:15; EST: 06:30–07:15)
- Option C: Thu, Nov 19 — 15:00–15:45 UTC (PST: 07:00–07:45; EST: 10:00–10:45)

Notes:
- We can compress to 30 minutes if you prefer a high-level product walkthrough.
- Soojin, can you confirm SE availability for a security segment and whether a 45-min slot is preferred?

I’ve attached a short security questionnaire that might help your IT team prepare (security-questionnaire-lite.pdf). If you reply with the preferred window and attendee list I’ll send a calendar invite and a brief agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference
pri yom.das@redwood.com
(attachment: security-questionnaire-lite.pdf)

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@voltiva.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <t.blake@voltiva.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 17:05:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — proposed windows & IT/security check (Voltiva)

Hi Priyom — thanks for the quick follow-up. Voltiva is keen to see the walk-through; the primary attendees will be: me (Product), Tom Blake (IT/Security), and Lara (Procurement) — looping Tom here.

Our preference is Option B (Wed 11:30 UTC), but Tom says IT can only make it at 11:30–12:00 UTC if we keep the security segment tight. If you need all 45 minutes we can push to Option C on Thu, but that’s less ideal for product stakeholders.

Two quick asks from Tom: 1) can Redwood confirm whether the demo will cover SAML and data retention controls? 2) Can you share the short checklist with our security team (we may need it for our procurement review).

Maria
Maria Gomez
Product Manager, Voltiva Systems
maria.gomez@voltiva.com

Thanks Maria — this is helpful. Ava & Soojin: we should aim for Wed Nov 18, 11:30–12:15 UTC but compress the security segment to ~15 minutes so Tom can join the core session and the technical deep dive. If we need a longer technical follow-up we can schedule a separate SE/IT session.

Revised plan (final proposals):
- Primary: Wed, Nov 18 — 11:30–12:15 UTC (45 min) — we’ll split: 30 min product + 15 min security Q&A (Tom can join for the 15-min segment)
- Backup: Thu, Nov 19 — 15:00–15:45 UTC (45 min) if Tom needs a single contiguous block

Soojin — can you confirm you can join the 11:30 UTC window and whether you’re OK with a 15-min security Q&A rather than a longer deep-dive? Also note we’ll cover SAML, session handling, and retention at a high level.

Maria/Tom — I’ve re-attached the security questionnaire and added a short demo runbook (demo-runbook.pdf) for Soojin to use. I’ll send a calendar invite once we have confirmation.

Cheers,
Priyom
(attachments: security-questionnaire-lite.pdf, demo-runbook.pdf)

Hi all — I can join Wed 11:30 UTC (that’s 03:30 PST for me). The 15-min security Q&A is fine for the initial run — I’ll plan to cover:
- High-level SAML/OAuth flows we support
- Data retention defaults and configurable retention policies
- What we log (audit trail + token-level traces)

If Tom wants deeper detail (network/VPC peering, HSM/KMS integrations) I can follow up with a 30–45 minute technical session the week after.

Attached: demo-runbook.pdf (SE checklist & run order).

— Soojin

- 00:00–30:00 Product walkthrough: low-latency inference, routing policies, and cost controls
- 30:00–45:00 Security & architecture Q&A (SAML, retention, audit logs) — Tom, we’ll make sure this is first in the Q&A so you can join the critical piece.

Zoom link & dial-in will be in the calendar invite. If any attendee needs an earlier local time we can offer a recorded play-through for product stakeholders — let me know.

Thanks Maria, Tom — looking forward to it.
